scope: Ocular Health (anterior+posterior) finding→dx candidate suggestions, including dry eye syndrome (H04.12-), plus the staged families seeded in Wave B: nonexudative and exudative AMD (H35.31-/H35.32-), primary open-angle and low-tension glaucoma (H40.11-/H40.12-), and resolved diabetic macular edema (E10.37X-/E11.37X-). Cataract-by-type remains deferred.
